title: Owner: see drones, warehouse and a logged crash in NERV
goal: The owner sees the fleet cards and screens in NERV and logs a crash with approval
acceptance: The owner says the drones, spares and crash cards, the two full screens and the approved crash log work in NERV, or lists what differs; differences become steps or records in the repository that owns them
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one check in NERV once its consumer side exists; its page is written by the step that makes it runnable. Not a measurement.
